selected_dataset.title: Twin House Experiment IEA EBC Annex 71 Validation of Building Energy Simulation Tools - Specifications and dataset
selected_dataset.institution: Fraunhofer Institute for Building Physics (IBP), Holzkirchen, Germany
selected_dataset.publisher: Fordatis, Research Data Repository of Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft
selected_dataset.attribution: Kersken, Matthias; Strachan, Paul (2020). Twin House Experiment IEA EBC Annex 71 Validation of Building Energy Simulation Tools - Specifications and dataset, version 2. Fraunhofer IBP / Fordatis. https://doi.org/10.24406/fordatis/76.2 . CC BY-SA 4.0. Derived observations and analysis identify their changes and retain attribution.
selected_dataset.measured_channels: ten room-centre air temperatures, room electrical heater inputs and internal-heat-source inputs; on-site ambient temperature and solar irradiance
selected_dataset.field_semantics_evidence: specification sections 3.1, 3.9, 3.16, 5.1, 6.1 and 6.2; room/equipment naming and magnitudes cross-checked against the workbooks
selected_dataset.time: 10-minute averages, fixed UTC+1. Specification section 5.1 describes 1-second acquisition / 1-minute means; section 3.16 specifies 10-minute/hourly weather averages. Published DATE grids matched exactly.
selected_dataset.rawness: Files are original downloaded publication files, not untouched raw sensor readings: short failures have publisher interpolation/zero-fill. No row quality flags supplied.
selected_dataset.not_used: O5 records, simulated heating refills, setpoint columns, calculated DHW demand, calculated heat-pump or water-flow powers

attempts.source: PH02 Bacher and Madsen / DTU CTSM-R Building 2
attempts.outcome: Downloaded author example with measured Ta, Ph, yTi and Ps and explanatory PDF. ZIP has no licence notice; tutorial text and plot disagree on Ps W versus kW unit. Retained as discovery evidence only; not fitted or presented as licensed selected benchmark.

attempts.source: IEA Annex 58 Experiment 2, University of Strathclyde
attempts.outcome: Institution landing page identifies creator Paul Strachan and CC BY 4.0; specification/structure/data file URLs returned HTTP 403 in web and ordinary HTTPS retrieval. No credentials or bypass attempted; not downloaded for analysis.
Downloaded specification and 46,262,744-byte original main measurement ZIP. Confirmed CC BY-SA 4.0. Selected N2 only, with disclosed publisher processing.

redistribution_note: Selected original Fraunhofer and derived data use CC BY-SA 4.0. DTU downloaded files have unverified licence and are local discovery evidence; exclude them from a public delivery bundle pending licence confirmation. Existing research PDFs remain outside this independent data package and were only read.
